description: This file defines React hooks and utility functions for managing tasks in a task management frontend. It includes hooks for live task statistics, fetching, creating, updating, and listing tasks, with real-time updates via Supabase channels.

methods.name: useTaskStats()
methods.description: React hook to fetch and reactively update statistics about user's tasks, such as total, completed, open, due today, and overdue tasks.

methods.name: createTask(client, userId, { title, description = "", due_date = null, status = "open" })
methods.description: Function to create a new task record for a specified user via Supabase client.

methods.name: updateTask(client, taskId, patch)
methods.description: Function to update an existing task identified by taskId with given fields.

methods.name: getTask(client, taskId)
methods.description: Function to fetch a single task by its ID.

methods.name: listTasks(client, userId, { status, search } = {})
methods.description: Function to fetch a list of tasks for a user, optionally filtered by status and search text.

methods.name: useLiveTasks({ status, search } = {})
methods.description: React hook providing a live-updating list of tasks for the current user, with optional filtering.
